pkgmetadata.longdescription: HWMonux is a PySide6 monitor for temperatures, fans, voltages, power and load. It reads the kernel's hwmon interface (lm-sensors drivers), NVIDIA's NVML and USB cooler controllers. Fans and voltages of the motherboard only appear when the kernel has a driver for its Super I/O chip; the package loads the safe drivetemp module only and leaves the others to the user (sensors-detect).

use.flag: Read AIO coolers and fan controllers through liquidctl (needs the ~amd64 versions of liquidctl and hidapi)
Read NVIDIA GPU sensors through NVML (dev-python/nvidia-ml-py); harmless without an NVIDIA card
